'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Dialogue==
{{quote|Good day to you, mercenary. Very soon I will have a night-time meeting on a very important matter. Unfortunately, according to my intelligence in the region, the number of night sorties of your, uh, colleagues has noticeably increased. I feel that these are the same people who do not risk operating in the daytime. I want you to deal with them. These criminals cannot disrupt my work.}}

==Requirements==
* This quest is only obtainable by [[BEAR]] PMCs.

==Objectives==
* Eliminate 40 targets in the time period of 21:00-06:00 on [[Streets of Tarkov]], [[Lighthouse]], [[Reserve]], [[Ground Zero]] or [[Shoreline]]

==Rewards==
* +65,000 [[EXP]]
* +2 [[Aim Drills|Aim Drills skill]] levels
* +4 [[Submachine Guns|Submachine Guns skill]] levels
* [[Peacekeeper]] Rep <font color="green">'''+1.5'''</font>
* 2,750 Dollars
** 2,888 Dollars with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1
** 3,162 Dollars with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2
* 4× [[AFAK tactical individual first aid kit]]
* 1× [[CENS ProFlex DX5 tactical earplug]]
* Unlocks purchase of [[AFAK tactical individual first aid kit]] at [[Peacekeeper]] LL4
* Unlocks purchase of [[CENS ProFlex DX5 tactical earplug]] at [[Peacekeeper]] LL4
* Unlocks barter for [[SAPI level III+ ballistic plate]] at [[Peacekeeper]] LL4
{{quote|Good work, my friend! Everything went according to the plan.}}
